description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token on the client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html).

description.zh:
快照的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

默认值：空。
description.en:
The description of the snapshot. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty.
The ID of the database file system.

description.zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region where the DBFS instance resides. You can call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
设置快照的保留时间，单位为天。保留时间到期后快照会被自动释放，取值范围：1~65536

默认值：空，表示快照不会被自动释放。
description.en:
The retention period of the snapshot, in days. The snapshot is automatically released after the retention period expires. Valid values: 1 to 65536.

Default value: empty. This indicates that the snapshot is not automatically released.

description.zh:
快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以auto开头和dbfs-auto开头。
description.en:
The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

To prevent name conflicts with automatic snapshots, the name cannot start with \`auto\` or \`dbfs-auto\`.

descriptions.zh:
以下场景中，您无法为指定的数据库文件系统创建快照：

- 上一份快照还未完成创建。

- 数据库文件系统实例未处于已挂载（Attached）或者待挂载（Unattached）状态。
descriptions.en:
You cannot create a snapshot for the specified database file system in the following scenarios:

- The previous snapshot is still being created.

- The Database File System (DBFS) instance is not in the Attached or Unattached state.
